description: Send feedback from the person to the people who run Near Fine, such as a wrong price, a dead link, a missing bookseller or a search that found the wrong book. Use it only when the person asks to send feedback or agrees when you offer. Never send feedback on your own initiative. Before sending, show the person the exact message and wait for their approval. Put no personal details in it. Pass an email address only if the person chooses to give one for a reply. Pass the query or search_url it's about, if there is one. The email we get says it came from an assistant. Returns what was sent.

email.description: An email address for a reply, only if the person chose to give one

message.description: The feedback, exactly as the person approved it

query.description: The search the feedback is about, as passed to search_books

search_url.description: The search_url from search_books that the feedback is about

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
